Scan the setup QR, then enter a generated code on the website to finish enrollment. Your phone\'s automatic date and time should be enabled.
Nuvori doesn\'t save camera images. An imported QR image stays in your photos and contains your setup key, so delete it once your codes work.
Asks for your fingerprint or face if Nuvori was unlocked over a minute ago.

When Nuvori is your Autofill service, the tile uses the last app that asked Nuvori to fill a login or code in the past 5 minutes. No extra permission is needed. Usage access is only needed when Nuvori is not your Autofill service: it lets the vault inspect recent app activity when you open the tile. No usage history is stored. Browsers do not identify the website.
Choose the apps that should suggest this account. You can link several accounts to one app.
Choose the version to keep across paired devices.
Times may differ. Secret values stay hidden.
The note keeps the lines and formatting of both versions, with text found in both shown once. Check it afterwards and tidy anything repeated.
This name appears on paired devices. Your verified device ID stays the same.
If discovery cannot find this device, enter its current address from Android Wi-Fi settings. Addresses can change.
Enter a private Wi-Fi IP address
Keep both devices unlocked during setup. A device that already has items keeps them. Items that differ show up for review.
1. Scan this QR on the new device

On another Android phone, start with an empty vault. On Windows, scan this QR with the PC camera or use Copy link. The phone and PC must be able to reach each other across their local networks. Enter this phone\'s master password on Windows, then confirm the matching code before copying the vault.
2. Compare the code on both devices
Start a new pairing invitation from the managing device. You can still scan its QR code here.
Camera access was denied. Paste the setup link instead.
Setup link from the other device
Counts describe known changes at the last contact. Another device may have newer changes until the next check.
Choose the device that should take over. It accepts, then this device completes the handoff. Keep both devices syncing.
Only an Android phone or tablet can manage the group. A Windows PC can\'t take this role.
This device manages the group, so it can\'t leave yet. Transfer the managing role to another device first.
Start a separate group on this device instead
Both devices must use the same master password. Nothing is copied until they match.
This changes the password for this empty vault, then starts pairing.
To empty this device, sync first: some changes from it have not reached another device yet.
Enter this vault\'s master password. The new device must use the same password before it can receive a copy.
Your Drive stores encrypted changes only. On your other devices, connect the same Google account. Changes then sync through Drive whenever a device is unlocked and online.
Disconnect Google Drive on this device?
This device stops syncing through Google Drive. Sync over Wi-Fi keeps working. The encrypted files stay in your Drive for your other devices.
Nuvori saves an encrypted backup in a hidden folder of your Google Drive. It works without a sync group. On a new phone, sign in with the same Google account and restore it with your master password.
Backups run while Nuvori is unlocked. If the phone stays locked, the backup runs at the next unlock. Nuvori keeps this phone\'s newest backup and the one before it.
Backups open with your current master password. You need it to restore on a new phone, because Nuvori cannot recover it.
This phone stops making backups. The backups already in your Drive stay there, and you can still restore them. To delete them, remove Nuvori\'s hidden app data in your Google Drive settings.
This Google account has no Nuvori backups. Check that you signed in with the account of your old phone, and that Google Drive backup was on there.
Choose a backup. It replaces this vault after you review it.
This is the master password of your old phone when the backup was made.
Choose a question for steps and a shortcut to the right screen.

Linked native apps and exact HTTPS sites in verified Chrome and Brave releases can offer logins. Supported browser forms can offer Save after you unlock and confirm. The Quick copy tile still works with another provider.
Logins you fill most on this phone come first, and one per site is marked Most used. The counts stay on this phone.

In Chrome or Brave, enable autofill using another service in the browser\'s settings. The browser must expose Android autofill fields. HTTP pages, mismatched subdomains, ambiguous forms and unverified browsers are rejected.

In-app WebViews require you to choose a login after unlocking. The containing app can read filled credentials; approve only apps you trust. A website link does not authorize an embedded app. If nothing appears, open the page in Chrome or Brave, or copy from the Quick copy tile.
Only authorize apps you trust. Selecting Done approves the installed apps\' current signing identities. Suggestions based on recent app usage do not authorize autofill.
The code stays in Codes and is shown with this login. Deleting this login will not delete the authenticator.
Add an authenticator in Codes first.
Choose what to do after you create your master password.
Stored encrypted with your vault. Included in backups and in sync with your devices.
Nothing yet. New passkeys, sign-ins and deletions appear here.
This removes the history list on this device. Your passkeys stay saved. This can\'t be undone.

No requests yet. If an app lists other managers but nothing shows here after you try it, either Nuvori is turned off as a provider (use the button above), or the app uses Google\'s older sign-in method, which offers only Google\'s own manager.
This replaces the password in this form. It does not change the password at the service. Nothing is saved until you save the login.
Kept on this phone only, up to 10.
This phone forgets the earlier passwords of this login. The current password stays.
This phone forgets its copy. You can\'t undo this.

When you sign in to a site with Google, Apple, GitHub or another account in your browser on Windows, the Nuvori extension asks to remember which one you used. Sync brings it here, and Autofill reminds you on that site.
On your PC, sign in to a site with “Continue with Google”, GitHub, Microsoft, Apple or another provider, and choose Save when the extension asks. After the next sync it shows here.
Try another site, or clear the filters.
Kept in your encrypted vault. Nuvori never stores a password, token or code from these sign-ins. Provider logos only show which sign-in you used.
Nuvori stops reminding you about it on all your devices. The site and your account there are not changed.
You may not need a password here: use that button on the site.
Nothing to copy. Add details in Nuvori.
%1$s changed the master password for your synced devices. Enter the new password to use it on this phone too.
Sync is paused on this phone until then. Until you switch, this phone still opens with its current password.
%1$s changed the master password. Sync is paused on this phone until you enter it.

Linked to your vault, but it has not synced yet. If pairing did not finish on it, remove it here and pair it again.
Wi-Fi couldn\'t reach it on the last check.
If the prompt doesn\'t appear, tap Use fingerprint or face to try again.
Replace this vault with the backup?
Everything in this vault now is replaced, and you can\'t undo it.
Afterward, unlock with your current master password, not the backup\'s. Then turn on fingerprint or face unlock again.
Your unsaved changes will be lost.
The entries in this folder will remain in your vault.
Changed passwords default to keeping the saved value. Apply a bulk choice, then adjust individual accounts below.
Ambiguous accounts match more than one saved login. They will not be changed.
The export file contains readable passwords. Delete it after checking the import.
Match each heading. Samples are masked, and password samples are always hidden.
Choose three different required columns. Optional columns must also be different.

This removes the item from this phone and from your paired devices on the next sync. This phone keeps a copy in Recently deleted for 30 days (Settings > Recently deleted). Its photos are deleted for good.
Drag the edges or corners. Drag inside to move. Save replaces this vault photo.
On: forms fill these details from an encrypted device copy without unlocking. Off: Nuvori asks you to unlock first. Applies to all saved profiles.
Select an entry to see its details.
Use the exact HTTPS website for browser autofill.
Choose which details to save. Nuvori fills only fields it can identify.
Hold your card against the phone
Keep the contactless card still against the back of your phone. Only readable details will be filled in; nothing is saved until you tap Save.
Keep each bank or service together: cards, logins, codes, questions and notes.
Tap + to create your first group.
Link entries to bring this group\'s details together.
Only this group and its notes are deleted. Linked entries remain in your vault.
Supports ES256 passkeys for websites and native apps that use Android Credential Manager. Apps using legacy FIDO APIs, enterprise attestation, or unsupported extensions cannot offer Nuvori.

You can also scan a standard TOTP setup QR, choose a Zoho OneAuth encrypted JSON export, or import a text file with one otpauth://totp link per line. Microsoft Authenticator does not provide a compatible account export.
Review these accounts before saving. Imported codes do not remove them from the original app. Check a code on each website before deleting the original.
Tap Sync codes now once with the watch connected to switch it to a new watch key.
A disconnected watch keeps its current codes until it reconnects and receives the removal.

Nuvori sends updated accounts after you add, edit, or delete a code, and each time you unlock it on this phone. Changes reach the watch when it reconnects. The watch shows when it last received codes.
On the watch, tap a code to show it full screen. The ring around the edge counts down, and the next code appears in the last 10 seconds.
Sync may use Google\'s encrypted Wear OS relay when Bluetooth is unavailable. Only authenticator accounts are sent.
A cloud file provider may upload an encrypted backup outside this app.

Your vault is encrypted on this device. There\'s no Nuvori account or server. Optional sync uses your Wi-Fi or your own Google Drive, which stores only encrypted files. Keep an encrypted backup and its password somewhere safe. Nuvori hasn\'t had an independent security audit.
Oldest copy kept. All saved fields and relationships match.
A conflicting credential ID cannot be overwritten. Cancel this import and remove the conflicting passkey only after confirming you have another sign-in method.
Backup files you saved yourself still open with your old password.
Enter the password you set when you exported this JSON file. Nuvori will decrypt it on this device and show the accounts before saving.
Fill once uses it this time only. Nothing in your vault changes.
A master password starts a new fingerprint session. Fingerprint use does not extend it.
Generate new password for this account
No matching passkeys in this vault.

Save the username or email, generated password, and website link for %1$s before filling. Submit the website form to finish. If it rejects the password, remove the generated login. Your old login will remain unchanged.
Replace the saved password for %1$s at %2$s in \"%3$s\"? The old password is replaced and can\'t be recovered. Groups, photos and the linked authenticator code stay unchanged.
Open Nuvori to create your vault first.
No saved logins match this search.

This password is already saved in Nuvori.
Keep an encrypted backup to transfer it to another phone.
Pick an accent and a background. The whole app changes at once.
Add a card in Nuvori. Nuvori can then fill its number, name and expiry here.
Choose a card. Only the card fields this form asks for are filled.
Suggest codes for the previous app
If you use another Autofill service, allow Usage access to put codes for your previous app first.
A deleted version removes this record.
The incoming passkey cannot replace another credential with the same ID. Keep this device\'s version, then register a new passkey on the website.
Waiting to send: %1$s. Waiting to apply here: %2$s.
Waiting to apply there: %1$s. Waiting to arrive here: %2$s.
Create a QR on the managing device
Open Devices & sync there and tap Create QR.
On the empty device, tap Scan QR and point the camera at the code.
Confirm the same code appears on both devices before the vault copy starts.
Scan Windows QR if the PC cannot reach this phone
Up to 6 mobile devices and 2 Windows PCs share this vault. Each keeps its own copy and catches up when connected. %1$s manages the group.
Nuvori checks your paired devices while it can reach them on Wi-Fi.
Allow notifications to keep automatic sync active when Nuvori is closed.
The managing device adds and removes devices and holds pairing invitations. Vault items sync the same on every device.
%1$s accepted. Sync both devices, then complete the transfer.
Open Devices & sync on %1$s and accept. Keep both devices syncing.
Waiting for %1$s to complete the handoff.
%1$s offered this device the managing role. Both devices must finish syncing before you accept.
Remove this device from the group
This device keeps its vault copy and stops syncing. %1$s removes it from the group; no one needs to approve.
Lost %1$s? Mark it as lost. This device then stops taking changes from it.
This device no longer takes changes from it. Make this device the managing device of a new group, or scan the QR of a device that already did.
Scan the QR shown on the other device. Keep both devices unlocked on reachable local networks.
%1$s doesn\'t need to approve. It keeps its own copy of the vault. Your devices stop accepting its changes, and it sees a notice the next time it reaches any of your devices.
%1$s can\'t read anything you add from now on.
If %1$s was connected to Google Drive sync, also remove Nuvori\'s access in your Google account.
This device stops taking changes from %1$s. Your items stay. You can undo this.
This device keeps its items and manages a new group. Then pair your other devices with it. They keep their items too, with no duplicates. %1$s can\'t read anything you add after that.

This device keeps its vault and starts a separate sync group with new keys. The other devices keep their copies, but nobody can add or remove members in the old group until it has a managing device again. Pair the watch again for codes.
This device stops syncing with the group. %1$s removes it the next time they connect; no approval is needed. Changes waiting to arrive here must finish first. Pair the watch again for codes.
Step 1 of 3. %1$s must be up to date and accept. Then you complete the handoff here. You can cancel at any step. This device keeps syncing items afterwards.
Step 2 of 3. This device will add and remove devices after %1$s completes the signed handoff. Vault items keep syncing on every device.
Your devices sync through your Drive when they are not on the same Wi-Fi.
Every change is encrypted on this device before it is uploaded.
Nuvori can\'t see or change your other Drive files.
Use the same Google account on every device.
Google needs you to sign in again
Access was removed or expired. Nothing is lost. Sync over Wi-Fi keeps working.
Access was removed or expired. Your vault on this phone is safe.
Backs up %1$s while Nuvori is unlocked. A backup opens with your master password.
Use a backup that Nuvori saved in your Google Drive. Sign in with the Google account of your old phone.
Star an item or open one, and it shows up here.
Linked native apps and exact HTTPS sites in verified Chrome and Brave releases can offer logins. Supported browser forms can offer Save after you unlock and confirm.
Nuvori is not your Autofill service
Choose Nuvori in Android to fill saved logins in supported apps and websites. This replaces your current Autofill provider.
Modern Android apps use Credential Manager. Enable Nuvori there for passwords and passkeys as well.
Choose what you see after unlocking a login suggestion.

Off by default. After you pick a login, Nuvori fills its linked authenticator code on the next screen when the app or site has a code field Nuvori recognizes. Turn this on as a fallback to also put the code on the clipboard for 30 seconds. Your keyboard and the app in front can read the clipboard.
Remind me how I signed in

On by default. When Nuvori for Windows remembered that you used \"Continue with Google\" or another provider on a site, Autofill there shows \"Last time: Google · your account\". It never fills a password. Tapping it fills only that account, into an empty account field you are in.

On by default. Payment forms in apps and supported browsers show \"Unlock to fill a card\". After you unlock, you pick a card, and Nuvori fills its number, name and expiry. The security code fills only while its switch is on, and needs your fingerprint if Nuvori was unlocked over a minute ago.
On by default. Address and contact forms show \"Unlock to fill your details\". After you unlock, you choose which saved details to fill. The suggestion itself shows none of your details.
Offer saved details without vault unlock

Off by default. When on, email, phone, name and address profiles get a separate device-encrypted copy, and forms fill them without unlocking. When off, Nuvori asks you to unlock first. Profiles sync through the vault, then the copy refreshes here after this device unlocks.
Anyone using your unlocked phone can choose these details without the vault password. Passwords and authenticator codes still require unlock.
Copy your vault from another phone or PC
From Google Drive or a .pvault file
From a browser or password manager export
ES256 (ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256) · stays in your encrypted vault
When each passkey was added, synced, used or deleted. Kept encrypted on this device only; not synced or backed up.
Apps and websites that asked Nuvori, newest first. The last %1$s stay encrypted on this device; no account or key is kept.
Leaves out l, I, O, 0 and 1
Choose details to fill. Only the fields this form asks for are filled.
Entries deleted on this phone or on a paired device stay here for %1$s days. A restored entry syncs to your other devices. Photos and passkeys are not kept.
This phone forgets all %1$s deleted entries. You can\'t undo this.

To fill and link a login instead, return to its sign-in field and choose Nuvori Autofill.
Use at least %1$s characters. A phrase of four or more words is easy to remember and hard to guess. If you forget it, Nuvori can\'t reset it.
Try a different name or keyword.
Forms show \"Unlock to fill your details\". After you unlock, you choose which details to fill.
Choose a password CSV from a browser or password manager, or an unencrypted Bitwarden JSON export. You will review the accounts before saving. This does not import passkeys.
Choose how Nuvori looks on this device.
Turn off for a black background.
Logos for popular sites are built in. Icons that Nuvori for Windows saves from your browser arrive through sync. This phone downloads nothing.
Create passkeys from a supported website in Chrome or Brave. They are encrypted with your vault and included in backups. Deleting one here does not remove its registration on the website.
Enable Nuvori for passwords and passkeys
Creating and using passkeys requires Android 14 or newer. Stored passkeys remain included in backups.
Android will show managers that support secure credential transfer. Browsers are listed only when their credential provider offers an export.
In Google Authenticator, choose Transfer accounts, then Export accounts. Scan every QR page before importing. A second device may be needed to display the codes.
Choose OneAuth JSON or TOTP text file
Plaintext TOTP files contain readable setup keys. Delete them after checking the imported codes.
Scan the remaining QR pages to continue.

Copy passwords, codes, card details and security answers from Quick Settings after unlocking. After one copy, the other fields of that item stay in your notifications for 2 minutes. The tile works with any Autofill provider.
When you open the tile, Nuvori can put codes for your previous app first.
Install Nuvori on the watch and connect it to this phone. The watch keeps an encrypted copy of your authenticator accounts so it can show codes without the phone. The watch must have a screen lock.
Next: restore your backup. Find it in Google Drive, or choose a .pvault file. Enter the password used when it was made, and review its contents before replacing this new vault.
Next: choose a password CSV or an unencrypted Bitwarden JSON export. Review the accounts before saving them to your vault. Passkeys are not included.
Save your vault to a .pvault file protected by a password, or restore one. A restore is checked and reviewed before it replaces anything.
Find password entries whose saved fields, tags, folders, and app or website links match exactly. Entry IDs and activity dates are ignored. Entries with photos are never included.
The vault locks after you switch apps. Screen-off always locks immediately.
The countdown starts after your last interaction. Switching apps never extends it. A file or photo picker that Nuvori opens counts as time in the app, for up to 10 minutes.
How often Nuvori asks for your master password. In between, you unlock with fingerprint or face, for up to 1 week.
Changing this ends the current fingerprint or face session. Enter your master password after the next lock to start a new one.
Existing backup files keep their original passwords.
Paired devices must keep the same master password. Remove paired devices before changing it.
Ask for the master password less often?
You\'ll type your master password less often, so it\'s easier to forget. Nuvori can\'t reset it, and a forgotten password means a lost vault.
For up to 7 days, anyone whose fingerprint or face unlocks this phone can open your vault.
Remove the passkey for %1$s at %2$s? Make sure you have another way to sign in. Older backups may still contain it.
Nuvori can\'t reset this password. If you forget it, your vault can\'t be recovered.
Scan every page from Google Authenticator or a standard TOTP setup QR. No camera images are saved.
